import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int m = sc.nextInt();
        double[] p = new double[20];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            p[i] = sc.nextDouble();
        }
        double[] res = new double[1 << 20];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            res[1 << i] = p[i];
        }
        double[] q = new double[20];
        for (int i = 1; i < (1 << n); i++) {
            List<Integer> v = new ArrayList<>();
            List<Integer> w = new ArrayList<>();
            double sum = 0;
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if ((i >> j & 1) == 1) {
                    v.add(j);
                } else {
                    w.add(j);
                    sum += p[j];
                }
            }
            if (v.size() == m || (v.size() < m && sum < 1e-5)) {
                for (int x : v) {
                    q[x] += res[i];
                }
            } else if (v.size() < m) {
                for (int x : w) {
                    res[i | (1 << x)] += res[i] * p[x] / sum;
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            System.out.printf("%.15f ", q[i]);
        }
        System.out.println();
    }
}
